text.en:
Increases Explosive Damage by 0.63% for every meter after 10 meters.

25% Increased Explosive Damage at 50 meters.

Increases overall damage by 17% at 50 Blast Radius Stat for Drum-Loaded Grenade Launchers.

enhanced (
